reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed donor-average treatment contrast with hierarchical comparison, donor-grouped resampling and null calibration, and protected donor-level validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original experimental Methods/supplements to verify allocation and sampling conditions and release-specific model protocols. Reconstructing identifiers and naming prior evidence alone is insufficient.

checks.quote: a two-sample comparison across donor summaries
checks.reason: No selected primary test/fitting algorithm or conditional outcome-family/link implementation. Generic donor comparisons and random intercepts do not fully specify the computation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: Reference samples and assay controls are named without an objective calibration-to-acceptance procedure or defined control failure gate.

checks.quote: stop enrolling donors when the pre-specified donor-level interval-width target is met
checks.reason: Repeated data-dependent precision stopping is not accompanied by a calibrated sequential interval/stopping procedure. Missing donor and biological-loss handling are also unspecified.

checks.quote: randomly reassign arm labels to donors
checks.reason: The permutation description does not preserve the proposed batch blocks; no operational interval construction/multiplicity method is selected.

checks.quote: the test for treatment approximates donor-level degrees of freedom
checks.reason: A random intercept alone does not ensure an appropriate small-sample reference distribution or denominator degrees of freedom. The inferential approximation requires explicit assumptions/correction and calibration.

checks.quote: grid these ranges from pilot data or literature priors
checks.reason: No bounded sensitivity candidate set or operational range-derivation and stopping rule is provided.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: No explicit refreezing and fresh independent confirmation after a changed or failed analysis protocol.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: No immutable raw hashes, executable environment and exact commands link records to numerical outputs.

checks.quote: no cell from a validation donor appears in training
checks.reason: Donor grouping is correct, but all fitted preprocessing, features and tuning steps are not explicitly restricted to each training fold.

checks.quote: disclose the confound, include batch terms, and flag reduced causal strength
checks.reason: The troubleshooting rule permits adjustment under severe confounding, whereas the final limit says it requires redesign. No overlap/rank gate resolves that conflict, and missingness/cluster-size stress is not operational.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: No clean-environment numerical rerun with tolerances and runtime/resource/failure logs.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Treatment Assigned at Donor/Animal Level with Many Cells/Fields per Donor
checks.reason: The main donor-unit rule and low-ICC limitation are correct; independent-cohort validation and precision planning are useful. Operational fitting, restricted randomization, small-sample inference and the confounding gate remain incomplete.
